verdict.rationale: Notte documents a hosted agent-start API endpoint (Bearer-token authenticated) that runs web AI agents on natural-language tasks inside cloud browser sessions, so the agent never manages a browser itself. The pack shows no endpoint for polling agent status or results, and no registrable webhooks. missing for 10: documented status/result polling endpoint, webhook callbacks for task completion, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of the async task flow.
